_comment: Shared by every service built from this repo, which is why
dockerfilePath is NOT pinned here any more.
It used to say "Dockerfile". A config file beats the environment, so
the apply-worker service ignored its own
RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH=worker/Dockerfile and built the WEB image --
and came up running uvicorn, looking for all the world like a
successful deploy. A second copy of the site, serving nothing anybody
visits, while the apply queue sat untouched.
Left unset, Railway uses ./Dockerfile by default, which is what the web
service wants, and RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH now actually applies to any
healthcheckPath stays, and is shared on purpose: the worker answers
/api/health itself now (see worker/run.py). A worker nobody can ask
'are you alive and is the queue moving' is one you hear about from a
